name: Edit an existing trip and recalculate the allowance

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?today=2026-10-19&fresh=1 (pins today to 2026-10-19 and clears saved trips in storage key ninety.trips.v1)
Click the add trip button (data-testid=trip-add), enter entry 2026-09-01 and exit 2026-09-03 (data-testid=trip-entry, trip-exit) and click save (data-testid=trip-save)
Days used (data-testid=days-used) shows 3 and days left (data-testid=days-left) shows 87
Click edit (data-testid=trip-edit) on that trip, change the exit date to 2026-09-10 and click save (data-testid=trip-save)
There is still exactly one trip row (data-testid=trip-row), now 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-10
Days used shows 10 and days left shows 80
